read.thesis: Rio Tinto H1 2026 volumes up 3% CuEq, but guidance held and copper C1 cost cut to 30–50c/lb; Pilbara port capacity drag and ~$1.2bn working-capital build temper the quarter despite Q2 Pilbara sales up 7%.

capex.quote: Port outload capacity will reduce to below 360 Mtpa during some quarters in H2 2026, 2027 and 2028 with several scheduled major capital projects underway

triggers.label: Copper C1 cost cut to 30–50c/lb
triggers.quote: Guidance range reduced to US 30 - 50c/lb (from US 65 - 75c/lb) due to higher than expected gold prices and productivity improvements.

triggers.label: ~$1.2bn working capital outflow in H1
triggers.quote: we saw a cash outflow of ~$1.2 billion from an increase in working capital. Drivers include higher inventories, primarily in iron ore

triggers.label: Port outload capacity below 360 Mtpa
triggers.quote: Port outload capacity will reduce to below 360 Mtpa during some quarters in H2 2026, 2027 and 2028

triggers.label: Q2 Pilbara sales up 7% YoY
triggers.quote: Q2 sales: up 7% YoY and the highest since 2020 supported by strong system performance and healthy stock levels.

guidance.quote: Guidance range reduced to US 30 - 50c/lb (from US 65 - 75c/lb)
Pilbara iron ore unit cash costs unchanged

red_flags.label: Kennecott smelter furnace breach, ~75-day rebuild
red_flags.quote: A flash converting furnace breach in June 2026 resulted in an unplanned outage at the smelter.

red_flags.label: Mongolia tax assessment paid under reservation
red_flags.quote: Oyu Tolgoi paid this amount in full in March 2026 reserving its rights to dispute the payment.

red_flags.label: Yarwun alumina output cut 40% from Oct 2026
red_flags.quote: production is set to reduce by 40% starting from October 2026 (~1.2 Mt impact per year).
